title: Geometric area with a sign change · Set 2
statement:
Use geometry to find the total area between $y=x-[$a]$ and the axis on $[0,2([$a])]$.

[__________]{a}
hints: Split the line at its zero.
The two triangular areas have equal magnitude.
For total area, add both magnitudes.
solution: Each triangle has base $[$a]$ and height $[$a]$. The two areas sum to $([$a])^2$.

feedback.message: For total area, add both magnitudes.
